rationale: sweep Aug23: Manchester City came in late. ESPN (Aug 20) reported advanced talks, Romano says the player has a verbal agreement, Estadao (Aug 21) says City will pay EUR37.5m + EUR4.5m bonuses, and Portal do Palestra/nsctotal (Aug 23) say Palmeiras accepted the bid, with only signatures, medical and the announcement left. Villa's earlier EUR25m+5m bid was rejected.

sweep Aug23: Porto are now the concrete suitor. Nau.ch/DZFoot (Aug 21) call the interest 'very concrete' and say Porto would pay above his EUR7m market value, and Sport1.pl (Aug 23) calls him Porto's main left-back target. Como, Genoa, Hull and unnamed Turkish clubs are also monitoring, but no agreement has been reported.

sweep Aug23: AVROTROS decides on 2027 at the end of August or early September (AD Aug 18; minister Aug 20), the only scheduled August decision, but De Telegraaf (Aug 19-20) says NL will return and Shownieuws (Aug 23) calls it 50/50. RTVE's red line remains Israel's participation plus the Russia 'double standard', and it framed 2026 as about neutrality (Infobae Aug 13), so Spain is raised. No 2027 boycott had been announced by Aug 23.

sweep Aug23: There is still no 2026 US measles death; ProPublica (Aug 18) counts 3 deaths since the start of 2025, all in 2025. Pennsylvania cases are 'surging' (Lehigh Valley Aug 4, Pittsburgh Aug 10/21), Texas has school-season cases, Florida has an outbreak (Donalds on CBS, Aug 23), and Utah is slowing.

sweep Aug23: The Kalshi market (Aug 16) has Bruno Fernandes at 83c and Rice at 19c, with others at 1-2c. The ceremony is Aug 25. Bruno already won the FWA award and PL Player of the Season, while Arsenal's three nominees may split the vote.

sweep Aug23: TASS (Aug 23) reports the Witkoff/Kushner Moscow visit is delayed and 'unlikely before the end of August'. The Kremlin (Aug 19-20) had no date, and Zakharova says Moscow could arrange a meeting at short notice. No US official has visited Moscow in August so far; Gilman was released Aug 11 with no official in Moscow. Conditional on a CBS-reported visit, Witkoff is still the likeliest.

sweep Aug23: FootballTransfers/Athletic (Aug 18) say Chelsea keeping Emegha all but confirms Jackson leaves permanently (asking EUR65-75m). Schira (Aug 13) says talks with Villa are progressing and Jackson has said yes, and Villa had no fit centre-forward at Brighton on Aug 23 with Watkins heading to Al Hilal. No club-to-club fee has been agreed yet.

sweep Aug23: No Middle East trip has been reported. Xi's announced travel is the SCO in Bishkek (Aug 31-Sep 1), BRICS in New Delhi (Sep 12-13), Washington (Sep 24) and APEC in Shenzhen. The ongoing Iran war makes Gulf stops risky. Unchanged.

sweep Aug23: Liverpool made an improved EUR135m bid (Aug 17) and PSG are reportedly willing to take EUR130-140m. RMC (Aug 17) says an agreement is expected and Romano says Barcola has agreed personal terms. Barcola was left out of PSG squads on Aug 16 and Aug 22 pending a move. Arsenal have had no club-to-club talks, so conditional on a move it is overwhelmingly Liverpool.

sweep Aug23: Juventus are out after signing Vicario on loan (Aug 17), and Villa signed Suzuki (Aug 19). Emery confirmed Martinez asked to leave (Aug 21), and he was absent from Villa's squad on Aug 23 with the Guardian calling him 'set to leave'. Tottenham need a keeper after Vicario's exit and are the bookmakers' favourites (talkSPORT 2/1, Aug 19), ahead of a Saudi club (6/1), Chelsea (10/1) and Man Utd (16/1).

sweep Aug23: Manchester City (Maresca) are now the only real suitor. They missed Chelsea's Aug 14 deadline for the GBP120m price, but reports (Aug 21-23) say they are still interested and may bid late, and Enzo told Chelsea he wants to leave. Real Madrid now have Mourinho and Bernardo Silva and have not been linked lately.

sweep Aug23: No Kremlin schedule for the Bishkek SCO (Aug 31-Sep 1) has been found yet; Ushakov usually briefs a few days before. Russia's Aug 15 demand for an explanation from Turkey over possible Ukraine arms transfers keeps Erdogan as a natural Ukraine interlocutor. Unchanged.

sweep Aug23: BBC and GiveMeSport (Aug 23) report Al-Hilal in talks with Arsenal, willing to top Galatasaray's EUR45m bid, and Martinelli is open to the move. Arsenal want EUR60-70m and Arteta has told him he is surplus. He rejected Galatasaray (Aug 13-14), and no other top-five-league club has made concrete interest.

sweep Aug23: The race is Aug 30, and the field is very deep, with 19 entrants faster than the 2:06:06 course record (Running Week, Aug 14). Simbu is the world champion and Kiros the defending champion. No withdrawals found. Unchanged.
sweep Aug23: No field changes found before the Aug 30 race. World champion Jepchirchir headlines but is returning from a stress fracture, and Hassan is not entered (she targets New York). Unchanged.

sweep Aug23: Everton and Ipswich contacted Arsenal (AS via Mirror/TransferFeed, Aug 19-20), and Jesus wants to stay in the PL. Moretto (Aug 20) says he is 'not currently open' to Napoli despite a claimed GBP17m club deal (low-quality source, Aug 15). Milan look unlikely after their club-record Goncalo Ramos signing. Arsenal want GBP17-20m.

sweep Aug23: Ynet (Aug 22): Ra'am's national conference chose its slate as 1 Abbas, 2 Walid Taha, 3 Walid al-Huashla, 4 Iman Khatib-Yasin, 5 Yasser Hajirat, with slots 6+ and links to independents left to the executive committee. Segalovitz wanted No. 2 (Haaretz, Jul 31) and talks were ongoing on Aug 13, so a reshuffle is the main risk.

sweep Aug23: Rogers (GBP117m to Chelsea) still leads Anderson (GBP116m) and Tonali (about GBP98m). Liverpool's EUR135m bid for Barcola is about GBP116m, and PSG want EUR140-150m, so a completed deal could top Rogers. Chelsea value Enzo at GBP120m with City interested. Arsenal may bid for Alvarez if Atletico relent (GMS, Aug 23).

sweep Aug23: Renard took the Ivory Coast job in early August, so he is out. Talks with Queiroz collapsed over a USD150k/month demand (Pulse, Aug 14), but the GFA ExCo unanimously recommended keeping him, pending Sports Ministry approval and funding (Aug 18-20). Assistant Desmond Ofei is 'widely expected' to take interim charge for the Sep 23 qualifier against Ivory Coast, and Beaumelle has applied.

sweep Aug23: Trump and Bessent promise the 'most crushing' economic war on Iran, with details due at an Aug 24 press conference. Treasury has warned two unnamed larger Chinese banks and in recent weeks targeted Dubai exchange houses and shell firms (Aug 7). Chinese banks are the most-discussed target but carry Xi-visit risk; no bank has been named.

sweep Aug23: International sugar prices rose about 19% in August to Aug 19, with NY raws at a 14-month high (17.48c) and London whites at a 16-month high, and India is importing 1Mt of raw sugar (Aug 21). By comparison, wheat is up about 6.5% this month on the Black Sea halt (Aug 20), and crude rose about 6% (veg oils) while palm supply is comfortable. July FFPI: sugar +5.6%, cereals +3.4%, veg oils +2%.

sweep Aug23: Kalimantan fires are intensifying; Prabowo visited on Aug 22, sent three battalions and helicopters, and more than 200k ha burned Jan-Jul, worse than 2019 or 2023. Haze reached Sarawak, where the API hit 227 ('very unhealthy') in Serian on Aug 21, and Malaysia asked ASEAN to act (Aug 22), with El Nino strengthening. Malaysia is raised toward its API>500 emergency threshold.

sweep Aug23: In Madrid's opener at Espanyol (2-1, Aug 22), Bellingham headed the 9th-minute opener as an attacking midfielder, and Mbappe was not at his sharpest. Betis signed Troy Parrott (EUR20m, Aug 19-21), who may start ahead of Cucho.

sweep Aug23: Salon (Aug 22): Talarico has spent $25M+ on ads against Paxton's $119k and leads narrowly, Cook moved Texas to toss-up, and Republicans expect the 'cavalry' (SLF/MAGA Inc) soon. MAGA Inc's roughly $400M is still unspent, and Leavitt joins it at the end of August. The GOP plans to 'spend heavily' in Michigan against El-Sayed (WSJ, Aug 23).

sweep Aug23: Antonelli will take a grid penalty of at least 10 places, possibly starting at the back, at Monza for a full power-unit change (Wolff, Aug 23). Norris won the Dutch GP from pole (Aug 23), his second straight win with McLaren upgrades. Russell won the Dutch sprint and is Mercedes' lead at Monza. Hamilton was 4th and Leclerc 5th.

sweep Aug23: Bloomberg/ST (Aug 20): transmission is accelerating outside Ituri, with confirmed cases growing about twice as fast in North Kivu and Haut-Uele over the past week and Tshopo jumping more from a small base. Haut-Uele treatment centres are over capacity (Wamba at 4x beds) and Bas-Uele is a new area. Totals are 5,208 cases and 2,476 deaths, and the UN calls the growth 'exponential' (Aug 21).

sweep Aug23: In matchday one Barcelona won 5-0 at Elche (Aug 23) and Real Madrid won 2-1 at Espanyol with a 90th-minute goal in Mourinho's return (Aug 22). The big two remain near co-favourites, with Barca slightly ahead on form and goal difference.

sweep Aug23: 1892 Holdings (Bezos's K5 fund, Saverin, Mittal trusts) bought about 38% of Liverpool on Aug 14, with an option to take control, which makes Amazon a plausible new front-of-shirt partner. There is no sponsor news, and Standard Chartered reportedly won't renew after 2026-27.

sweep Aug23: England won the 1st Test by an innings with an all-seam attack (Aug 21). Robinson and Tongue took all 10 first-innings wickets (both 5-fers) and 8 each in the match; Archer took 3 and Atkinson 1 in the second innings. Carse was arrested in Derby on Aug 22 and is under ECB investigation, so he is dropped. Robinson is added.
sweep Aug23: No proposed rule text has been published yet. The Nation (Aug 19) and the Bulwark (Jul 24) expect many noncitizens to be treated as residents of their home countries. Unchanged.
